text:
Maya (PM): quick sync — planning scope for Optimize toolkit next sprint. main asks: (1) eval-triggered alerts for regressions on prompt sets, (2) a tiny `optimizectl` CLI for engineers to get batching/cache recommendations locally. thoughts? :thinking:

Sam (SRE): @Maya sounds good. Q: alerts should hit PagerDuty or slack-only? we need severity tiers.

Maya (PM): default to slack + ops paging for P1. SLO breach -> page. non-blocking regressions -> slack thread.

Andre (Eng): cli sounds useful. propose: `optimizectl analyze --model gptq --workload sample.json` returns batch/caching/quant recs. minimal deps.

Theresa (Product): also require a simple accept/reject flow for suggested quantization before rollout. keep user in loop.

Sam (SRE): alerting config snippet idea:
```
alerting:
  channel: "#optimize-alerts"
  pagerduty: "team-inference"
  thresholds:
    p99_lat_drop: 5%
    quality_regression: 1.0% 
```

Andre (Eng): implementation note: prefer eval hooks push to event bus, then rules engine computes signal. can prototype with existing eval service.

Maya (PM): launch criteria proposal: 1) alerts firing on 3 pilot customers, 2) CLI alpha with <10MB deps, 3) doc + runbook for SRE. ok?

Theresa (Product): + acceptance: end-to-end demo with AcmeHealth on private deployment.

Sam (SRE): + we need oncall runbook and mute/ack flows. ops-bot: created incident runbook draft link: <https://confluence/redwood/optimize/runbook>

ops-bot: Reminder: deploy window tomorrow 08:00 PT for small infra changes :rocket:

Maya (PM): i'll draft an MVP scope and post PR for triage. tagging @Andre for cli prototype. :thumbsup:

Andre (Eng): will start on Monday. putting prototype in `tools/optimizectl`.

Theresa (Product): capturing customer asks and acceptance tests in GH issue: https://github.com/redwood/inference/issues/999

Maya (PM): thanks all. follow-up: meeting Wed 10am to lock deps.
